scope: Fresh native file-backed SQL/CAS observation only; no parser/proof/solver cache or admission threshold change.
preserved_checks: Fresh full SQL AST reconstruction and all relation verification
Fresh bounded CAS read, canonical decode and CID recomputation
Exact UTF-8 CAS payload versus freshly reconstructed SQL payload
Final active blob/file/revision, filesystem source and catalog-head fences
Native eligibility binding before read, after reconstruction and after active fence; custom/memory and pre-import wrapper fallback
limitations: No native Docker qualification or Terminal-Bench reward/token score is established by this package.
No RSS/cgroup memory reduction or lease admission recovery measurement.
Two timing samples per mode are a short local component diagnostic, not a statistically powered benchmark.
Existing final SQL identity fence does not newly prevent relation-only raw SQL tampering after the initial full relation audit.
Input and individual CAS payload bounds are not aggregate process RSS guarantees.
